versions.changelog:
- Removed unused file: skill-card.md.
- Updated default model in parameters from u1-insuremed to u2-med in documentation.
- No functional changes to code; documentation improved for consistency.

- Initial release of med-emr-qc-pe-missing-positive skill.
- Provides outpatient medical record quality control for missing key positive physical examination findings.
- Integrates multi-step LLM logic and condition branching in scripts/emr_qc_impl.py; supports text and multiple file formats (pdf, doc, xls, etc.) via run.py.
- Ensures privacy: operates on de-identified data, does not persist input/results, adheres to strict data security principles.
- Outputs either "无缺陷" (no defect) or "有缺陷" with explanation, leveraging an internal medical large language model.
